upgrades.name: Attack Speed
upgrades.description: Projectiles, Light Speed and Hook Bomb fire faster. Smart Missiles stay at two per second.

upgrades.name: Range
upgrades.description: Engage targets farther away. Shots finish their flight.

upgrades.name: Multishot Chance
upgrades.description: Projectiles and Light Speed can fire a multishot fan.

upgrades.name: Multishot Quantity
upgrades.description: Total projectiles in a multishot fan. Needs multishot chance.

upgrades.name: Rapid Fire Chance
upgrades.description: Normal volleys trigger short 4× firing bursts; active bursts cannot retrigger.

upgrades.name: Rapid Fire Duration
upgrades.description: Burst duration, from 0.25 to 0.5 seconds.

upgrades.name: Bounce Shot Chance
upgrades.description: Projectile and Light Speed hits can bounce to another enemy.

upgrades.name: Bounce Shot Range
upgrades.description: Target search distance from the previous impact.

upgrades.name: Bounce Shot Quantity
upgrades.description: Maximum ricochets per projectile. Needs bounce chance.

upgrades.name: Knockback Chance
upgrades.description: Projectile and Light Speed hits can push enemies back.

upgrades.name: Knockback Force
upgrades.description: Push distance, reduced by enemy resistance.

upgrades.name: Max HP
upgrades.description: Raises capacity and restores the newly gained HP.

upgrades.name: HP Regeneration
upgrades.description: Repair during combat, up to normal maximum HP.

upgrades.name: Thorns
upgrades.description: Bullet hits returned on contact damage; half damage to bosses.

upgrades.name: Orb Quantity
upgrades.description: Permanent orbiting defenses. Starts with no orbs.

upgrades.name: Orb Speed
upgrades.description: Rotation speed. Requires at least one orb.

upgrades.name: Land Mine Chance
upgrades.description: Kills can leave a mine that blasts and stuns survivors.

upgrades.name: Shockwave Size
upgrades.description: Radius of the automatic outward push.

upgrades.name: Shockwave Frequency
upgrades.description: Less time between automatic shockwaves.

upgrades.name: Coins Per Kill
upgrades.description: Multiply kill income before Golden Tower.

upgrades.name: Power Duration
upgrades.description: Extra duration for timed powers, excluding Demon Mode invincibility.

upgrades.name: Power Drop Chance
upgrades.description: Chance per kill, adjusted for wave density. Upgrades increase supply by the same proportion at every wave.

upgrades.name: Ammo Quantity
upgrades.description: Adds 20% per level to each refill: 30 Light Speed and 2 Smart Missiles; 1 Hook Bomb every fourth pickup.

upgrades.name: Ammo Drop Chance
upgrades.description: Ammo pickups per direct weapon kill.

upgrades.name: Overheal %
upgrades.description: Extra health capacity for Recovery Packages.

upgrades.name: Landmine Radius
upgrades.description: Increases landmine explosion radius.

upgrades.name: Landmine Damage
upgrades.description: Adds one hit of landmine damage per level.

upgrades.name: Wall HP
upgrades.description: Unlocks a wall that absorbs contact damage. Ranged attacks bypass it.

upgrades.name: Wall Rebuild Time
upgrades.description: Time to rebuild a destroyed wall. Requires Wall HP.

upgrades.name: Max Ammo Capacity
upgrades.description: Raises every finite ammo reserve. Does not refill ammo.
